name: Kitty Mulligan's Irish Pub
reviewNotes:
Added for its own event calendar in src/content/sources (PR #8). The dance floor has not been researched yet.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Facebook: the site links the numeric page facebook.com/383479678171873; Bing lists facebook.com/Kittymulligans/, which is most likely the same page (could not open Facebook to confirm). Email is a Gmail address, but it is the pub's published business contact. The site does not mention a dance floor; bands play in the bar room. Only 2 photos used; other site photos are food or show diners up close.
hours: Mon-Thu 11 AM-11 PM; Fri-Sat 11 AM-1 AM; Sun 11 AM-11 PM
description: A neighborhood Irish pub and grill in a shopping plaza on East Main Street in Bay Shore, with a free parking lot. It has live classic rock and local bands on Friday and Saturday nights, an open jam on some Sundays, and music bingo.

logo.alt: Kitty Mulligan's Irish Pub logo: white lettering and a green shamrock on a round black and green badge, Estb. 2021

photos.alt: Kitty Mulligan's at night: a lit Kitty Mulligan's sign and an Irish Pub sign with shamrocks over the storefront windows in a strip plaza
Inside Kitty Mulligan's: high-top tables on a wood floor, a stone wall with TVs and a barn door, with guests at tables

evidence.note: Venue site structured data and footer give 615 East Main Street, Bay Shore, NY 11706, phone 631-315-3571, email and hours; it links Facebook (page id 383479678171873) and Instagram (kittymulligans).
Events page lists live bands Friday and Saturday 7:30-10:30 PM (classic rock and local cover bands, no cover), an open jam on the 1st and 3rd Sundays 6-9 PM, and music bingo every other Thursday.
About page describes a family-friendly neighborhood Irish pub with live entertainment, a private party room and a free parking lot.
